0.0.n: A set phrase said to someone leaving, with the expectation that they will return.

1.0.n: A polite set phrase announcing your departure and implying that you will come back.

2.0.n: Borrowed from English, this is a casual, friendly farewell.

3.0.n: In 気をつける, this refers to the attention you give to staying safe or avoiding mistakes.

3.1.n: Marks 気 as what the action つける applies to in this fixed expression.

3.2.n: The て-form of つける makes a request here; together, 気をつけて tells someone to be careful.

3.3.n: This sentence-ending particle softens the request and adds a caring, friendly tone.

0.tip: Say this to see someone off, not to announce your own departure.

1.tip: The person leaving says いってきます; the person staying replies いってらっしゃい.

2.tip: This farewell is casual, so it suits friends and family rather than formal situations.

3.tip: Learn 気をつけて as a whole phrase meaning be careful or take care.
